findings.title: G4Media.ro reports AfD cyberattack exposing ~421,000 emails
findings.summary_md: A Romanian news outlet reports that Germany's far-right AfD party was hit by a cyberattack exposing roughly 421,000 internal emails. The article mentions an account linked to former AfD leader Alexander Gauland may be among those affected. The piece was published on October 20, 2026.

findings.title: HEIST Berlin analyzes 421,179 hacked AfD emails showing antisemitism and racism
findings.summary_md: HEIST Berlin reports that hackers published 281 GB of AfD emails (421,179 messages) as AI summaries, documenting widespread antisemitism, racist slurs, violent fantasies, and alleged financial misconduct within the German far-right party. The report was dated October 20, 2026.
